carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Unique vermiculated or labyrinthine white line patterns are visible in the shoulder region, situated between the posterior gill slits and the start of the standardized grid pattern.
